CheckTitle: ELBs without TLS minimum 1.2 or higher security policies
Description: ELB HTTPS and TLS listeners found not using an approved TLS 1.2 or higher security policy (such as ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01).
Risk: Using outdated TLS policies (such as those allowing TLS 1.0 or 1.1) exposes in-transit traffic to known cryptographic vulnerabilities and man-in-the-middle attacks.

Recommendation.Text: Update the load balancer listeners (HTTPS/TLS) to use a security policy that enforces a minimum of TLS 1.2, such as ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01 or ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06.
